main_text.p: raculum Christi, primo transfigurationis in monte, usque ad v. 37. deinde ejecti daemony [?] é puero quodam, usque ad v. 44. v I Dicta Christi, discipulos de passione iterum praemonentis, eosdemque ab ambitione dehortantis, usque ad v. 51.

p.i: Hactenus fuit prima pars administrationis muneris Prophetici Christi: sequitur Altera,

main_text.head: DE POSTREMA CHRISTI HIE-rosolymam SUSCEPTA PROFECTIONE.
main_text.p: HANC profectionem copiose describit Lu-cas, commemorans quid ubique hinc inde in via docuerit, & quibus miraculis doctrinam confirmarit: ubi, & apud quos diverterit: quomodo a singulis sit exceptus: quo fructu docuerit: quis fuerit comitatus: qui praecipui ho-stes, &c.

page.notes: The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. "daemony" is doubtful; the abbreviation after it is read as "é". "v I" is read as Roman numeral VI. The running head was set in capitals and u/v spelling was normalised as instructed.
